up: Retrieve canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units for compounds with exact activity measurements in assay CHEMBL4888485. Filter activities to only include rows where the standard relation is '='. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4888485' AND a.standard_relation = '='
